content: Ibn Turka's nephew Afżal al-Dīn Abū l-Fatḥ Muḥammad (son of Ṣadr al-Dīn) made a Persian translation and commentary on Shahrastānī's K. al-Milal wa-l-Niḥal, Tanqīḥ al-Adilla wa-l-ʿIlal, dedicated to Shāhrukh and finished 13 Rajab 843/20 December 1439; in his introduction he seems to allude to the tribulations his uncle suffered because of his views.
